name: City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, June 06, 2017 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Council Member Traina
d.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
A.
Anti-Gang and Drug Free Poster Winners
B.
Planning Commission Update
C.
City Water System Update - Presented by Public Works Director McAvoy
B.
Planning Commission Update
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not on the agenda will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
6.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
ACTION: That the Consent Calendar Items 7 a-j, be approved.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Regular meeting held on May 16, 2017
ACTION: That the minutes be approved.
Item#7b
c.
Approve the Demands and Payroll
ACTION: That the demands and payroll be received and filed.
Item #7c
d.
Adopt Ordinance No. 789
ORD 789 - AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA, AMENDING LOMITA MUNCIPAL CODE SECTION 6-8.06(A); WHEREBY INCREASING FINE AMOUNTS FOR MASSAGE ORDINANCE VIOLATIONS, AND SECTION 11-1.70.17(B)4; IN REGARDS TO TERMINIATING NONCONFORMING MASSAGE BUSINESSES WHICH OPERATE WITHOUT THE REQUIRED LICENSES. INITIATED BY THE CITY OF LOMITA. (Second Reading)
ACTION: That the City Council Adopt Ordinance No. 789.
Item#7d
e.
Approval of 2017 State of the City Event for November 16, 2017
ACTION: That the City Council approve the date and time of Thursday, November 16, 2017 from 12 p.m. to 2 p.m. for the annual State of the City event.
Item #7e
f.
Authorize Professional Services Agreement with HDL Companies for Sales Tax Management.
ACTION: That the City Council authorize the City Manager to sign the Agreement with HdL Companies.
Item #7f
g.
Council Meeting Date Change due to the 4th of July holiday.
ACTION: That the City Council, due to the 4th of July holiday, schedule regular Council Meeting of July 4, 2015 on the next business day, Wednesday, July 5, 2017.
h.
Citywide Telephony Equipment Software and Services Purchase
ACTION: That the City Council approve the expenditure of Information Technology funds to purchase new telephone equipment, ancillary software and support services for the citywide voice over internet protocol (VoIP) phone system for a total of $27,000.
Item#7h
i.
Approve Amendment No. 3 to Agreement for Street Sweeping Services with R.F. Dickson Company Inc.
ACTION: That the City Council approve a Third Amendment for Street Sweeping Services with R.F. Dickson Company, Inc. extending the term of the agreement through September 20, 2017, with no increase in compensation; and authorize the City Manager to sign Amendment No. 3.
Item #7i
j.
Approve Hazen & Sawyer Technical Memoranda Regarding Groundwater Treatment Operations and Distribution System Sampling and Monitoring
ACTION: That the City Council receive and file the attached technical memoranda and appurtenant attachments.
Item #7j
SCHEDULED ITEMS:
8.
CONSIDERATION AND POSSIBLE APPROVAL OF A PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH REGIONAL GOVERNMENT SERVICES TO PROVIDE ONGOING HUMAN RESOURCES STAFFING SERVICES Lomita City Council Meeting Agenda
Presented by City Manager Smoot
ACTION: That the City Council authorize the City Manager to execute a Professional Services Agreement with Regional Government Services for ongoing human resources staffing services in an amount not to exceed $50,000.
Item #8
9.
CONSIDERATION OF A CHAPTER 8 AGREEMENT AND RESOLUTION TO THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY TREASURER AND TAX COLLECTOR FOR THE FORMER LOMITA HOTEL PROPERTY LOCATED AT 24329 NARBONNE AVENUE
Presented by Assistant City Manager Sugano
Res 2017-15 - A resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita finding the acquisition of 24329 Narbonne Avenue (Assessor Parcen Number 7374-015-042) to be exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act and authorizing the City Manager to execute all documents necessary to purchase tax-defaulted property identified as 24329 Narbonne Avenue from Los Angeles County (Assessor Parcel Number 7374-015-042).
ACTION: That the City Council: 1) adopt a resolution finding the purchase of 24329 Narbonne Avenue [Assessor Parcel Number 7374-015-042] ("Property") exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act; 2) authorizing the City Manager to execute all documents necessary to purchase the tax-defaulted property from Los Angeles County ("County"), for a future public use - parking and/or open space and 3) adopt a project budget not to exceed $10,000.
Item #9
10.
ADJOURNMENT That the City Council meeting be adjourned in memory of Bill Haught, former City Parks employee and Parks and Recreation Commissioner to the next Regular Meeting to be held on Tuesday, June 20, 2017, at 6:30 p.m. in the Council Chambers of City Hall, 24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
